title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 resources; expanded audit logging for KMS selection and region-residency decisions; migration tool to backfill existing keys and resource metadata; rollout via feature flag and staged canary.
description: Context: customers require strict data residency and key management guarantees for Private and Dedicated deployments. This PR enforces RBAC v2 policies that pin resources to KMS regions and expands audit logging when KMS/residency decisions are made. Changes include policy evaluation enforcement, validation at resource create/update, a migration tool to backfill existing resources, and new audit events for KMS selection and region pinning. Migration: added `tools/kms_backfill` CLI that scans projects, validates KMS residency metadata, and annotates resources or opens remediation tasks for non-compliant entries. Rollout: gated behind feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_pin_enforce`; enable in staging, run migration, then progressively enable in 10%/50%/100% canaries. Testing: unit tests for policy evaluator, integration tests against mock KMS, end-to-end canary in staging. Security review: threat model updated, no new secrets stored; KMS ARNs validated against allowed regions. Backwards compatibility: default remains audit-only until feature flag enabled; full enforcement is non-breaking when rolled out per plan. See linked Linear tasks ENG-7421 and SEC-211 for design notes and compliance sign-off.

Priya Nair (author): Updated audit/events.go to store ARN SHA256 and included test to assert no plain ARNs appear in logs. Added a note in docs/security about redaction policy.

summary: Adds enforcement and audit improvements for KMS region pinning under RBAC v2, with migration tooling and staged rollout plan.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated; ops should coordinate: 1) enable feature flag in staging, 2) run kms_backfill --dry-run, review report, 3) run kms_backfill --apply, 4) enable enforcement at 10% canary, monitor audit events and errors, then continue rollout. Alert on kms_pin_failure events > 0.5%.
security_considerations: No new secrets persisted; KMS ARNs are hashed in audit logs; validation added to prevent cross-region KMS usage unless explicitly allowed by customer config. Non-compliant resources are annotated and left in audit-only mode until remediation.
